UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Player progression, high score, dengue hospitalization risk, and unlocked Special Equipment for killthebug.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: Player's display name shown in the HUD.

dengueLosses.description: Consecutive defeats toward the 3-loss Dengue hospitalization threshold (0-3).

unlockedEquipment.description: Bounded list of unlocked Special Equipment IDs (max 3).

equippedId.description: Currently equipped Special Equipment ID or 'none'.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last profile update.

RunRecord.title: RunRecord
RunRecord.description: Immutable match record for a completed 15s, 30s, or 60s killthebug Panic Attack run.

userId.description: Owner Firebase Auth UID matching the parent user document.

panicDuration.description: Selected Panic Attack timer in seconds.

superSmashes.description: Number of Right-Left-Clap JoJo Super Hand floor smashes triggered.

maxCombo.description: Highest kill combo streak in the match.

weatherPeak.description: Peak procedural weather intensity reached during the run.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the run was logged.

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-isolated player profile and equipment progression.
